articles.summary: IRVING, Texas, Nov. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — CMC (NYSE: CMC) (the “Company”) today announced the planned retirement of Paul Lawrence, who has served as the Company’s Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since 2019. The Company also announced a succession plan for the chief financial officer role, with the appointment of Kenji Hashimoto as Senior Vice President and Deputy Chief Financial Officer, effective November 16, 2026. As part of this transition, Mr. Hashimoto is anticipated to assume the chief financial officer role on January 15, 2027. Mr. Lawrence will remain employed by the Company through June 30, 2027, as Special Advisor to the CEO in order to support a smooth transition of the role. “On behalf of the Company’s Board of Directors and CMC’s leadership team, I want to thank Paul for his years of service,” said Peter Matt, President and Chief Executive Officer of CMC. “Paul has played a key role in driving the Company’s strong financial performance and building our healthy balance sheet, which have positioned CMC to undertake its transformation and create tremendous value for our shareholders.” “I am excited to welcome Kenji to CMC and the executive leadership team,” said Peter Matt. “His background brings […]
articles.title: CMC Announces CFO Retirement and Succession Plan; Appoints Kenji Hashimoto as Deputy CFO
